Application Data.NAME: Precision Auto Repair Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Precision Auto Repair Services specializes in comprehensive automotive repair, including diagnostics, routine maintenance, and mechanical repairs. Our services encompass oil changes, brake repairs, and electrical system diagnostics. We operate in a state-of-the-art facility that adheres to OSHA regulations, ensuring a safe working environment for our employees. Our premises are secure and well-maintained, featuring proper storage for automotive fluids and parts to mitigate environmental risks. We do not offer high-risk services such as racing modifications or emergency towing, allowing us to maintain lower liability exposures. Our business is committed to employee training and fire protection measures to ensure safety and compliance with industry standards.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2022, a customer reported damage to their vehicle while in our care, specifically a dent in the rear quarter panel caused by a tools drop during a brake repair service. The estimated repair cost was $5,000. The claim was settled amicably with the customer, and the status is closed.
